text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon's vigorous running strikes a chord with the audience, renewing their impressions of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She returns in an usually good mood. It seems as though this could be a new start for us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her win, a serious look comes over her face, and it seems as though she has something important to discuss.
